Please help! Shopify keeps billing me after I have closed my stores and I cant get them to stop.
items.summary: I signed up for a one dollar a month trial for two different stores. The trial period lasted for three months and then would go to $40 a month. Before the three month time period was up, I realized Shopify was not for me and I discontinued my stores. Now Shopify is charging me $41 a month for each store even though the stores have been closed for months. I cannot find anybody to talk to. I can’t find any email to send to handle this issue. items.title: AI Agents/Amazon Alexa
items.summary: Anyone seeing value in AI Shopping Assistants yet? I’m referring to how Amazon has it now with Alexa on sites. Its supposed to give users ideas of potential questions about the product, and responds as a conversation. Why we are looking at this: Our issue is - most of our pre-purchase questions are sizing and fit, and most of our returns are the same thing.
